subject: Nesting with more than one level in procD.lm

messages.author: 0155ba82ee6153f9
messages.subject: Nesting with more than one level in procD.lm
parts:
Dear geomorph community,

I have data of fly wings and other structures and I would like to run a procrustes anova.
My data contains individuals, which are from iso-female lines (i.e. families), which are nested within populations, which are nested within different continents.
I am aware of the nested.update function, however this only allows a nesting structure over one level. Does someone know a work-around or function, that allows to use a nesting structure over more than one level with the procD.lm function?
I know I could potentially use family mean shapes and drop the family term or similar, but I might lose interesting information like that.
I appreciate any help.
Cheers,

Julian
